subtitle: AI Video, One Click
apiKeyPlaceholder: Enter your Agnes API Key (get one free at platform.agnes-ai.com)
clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear the configured API Key?
clearEnvHint: The API Key is set via environment variable AGNES_API_KEY and cannot be cleared from the UI.
modelHint: Choose the Agnes models used for generation. Image and video models are not yet open; their defaults are kept.
modelBetaHint: The selected model is in beta: requires an API Key with beta access, otherwise calls will fail.
modelPaidHint: This is a paid model, billed by usage. Make sure billing is enabled.
vmModelNegativeUnsupported: Negative prompt is not supported by this model
vmNegativeDisabledPlaceholder: Negative prompt not supported by this model
vm720pHint: 720P = short edge 720px; output size scales with ratio
workspaceListHint: Click "Activate" to switch the current working directory
workspaceRegressionHint: This is a regression test workspace, locked by environment variable and cannot be changed from the UI.
workspaceRemoveConfirm: Remove this working directory from the list? (Disk files are not deleted)
watermarkPromo: Add an Agnes Video Generator watermark to help more creators discover this tool
promptPlaceholder: A ginger cat dozing on a rainy windowsill, sunlight streaming through the glass, curtains swaying in the breeze, 4K photorealistic
ideaPlaceholder: A robot watering a small flower in an abandoned city, 3 scenes: discovering the sprout, fetching water, the flower blooms
refDescription: Optional. All scenes use this as visual anchor. Auto-generated if not provided.
endFrameDesc: One end frame per scene, in order.
previewFailed: Preview failed, voice may not support this language
voiceCompatWarning: This voice may not support the current language. Use it anyway?
subStyleHintsHint: Describe how subtitles should vary in position, color, and size. AI will assign per-subtitle styles accordingly.
manuscriptPlaceholder: Paste your article, press release or blog post. For example: a 500-word product introduction or a travel essay - the system splits it into scenes automatically
sourceManualHint: Specify scene count and per-scene duration manually
sourcePromptHint: AI will analyze scene count and durations from the idea
pausePointsHint: Select checkpoints to pause in manual mode; unchecked ones pass automatically
manualUnsupported: This task type does not support manual mode
switchToAutoConfirm: Switching to auto mode will clear pause points and run to completion. Continue?
switchToManualConfirm: Switching to manual mode will pause at the next checkpoint for your review. Continue?
awaitingUserTip: Task paused at a checkpoint; review or edit artifacts then continue
handleAiDesc: Describe the change; system edits artifacts automatically
handleSelfDesc: View paths, edit files locally, then confirm
handleAgentDesc: Copy command and prompt, use a local agent, then confirm
handleEditDesc: Edit text artifacts in a modal and save, compare with the original anytime
aiModifyRequestPlaceholder: e.g. make narration of scene 2 more colloquial
continueToApply: Click "Confirm & Continue" above to apply changes
noEditableArtifact: No editable artifact in this checkpoint
selfEditAffectedHint: Affected artifacts will be deleted and regenerated; unaffected ones are kept
agentPromptTemplate:
Please review and optimize the artifacts of this checkpoint in task directory {dir}. Tell me the result when done, and I will click "Edited, Continue" in the web UI.

Requirements:
1. Keep artifact format and structure unchanged
2. Only modify semantic content
3. Report which files were changed
agentCommandLines: cd {dir} && traework\ncd {dir} && opencode\n# or another local agent (workbuddy / CodeBuddy CLI, etc.)
stopConfirm: Stop the current task? It can be resumed from the task list.
stopConfirmById: Stop this task? It can be resumed later.
stopped: Task stopped, resumable from task list
taskRunningWarn: A task is already running or queued
watchLog: Please check console logs and wait patiently.
genFailedMsg: Check console logs, then resume from task list.
connLostMsg: Connection lost. Server may still be running. Check task list for status.
domainHint: Choose the Agnes API access domain. .cn is recommended in China. Pick the domain that matches your key: global keys (issued at platform.agnes-ai.com) should use the Global or China fallback endpoint; China-only keys should use api.agnes-ai.cn. apihub.agnes-ai.cn is a China fallback not listed in the official docs and may be removed later.
domainCnBakLabel: China fallback (works with both domestic & global Keys; not in official docs, may be removed)
poemPlaceholder: Enter the full poem, e.g. 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟...
poemHint: Multiple stanzas allowed; separated by line breaks or punctuation. AI splits into scenes by meaning.
scenePromptsPlaceholder: Format: verse | visual description (one scene per line)
scenePromptsHint: Optional. One scene per line, fixed format "verse | visual description". Two ways give identical results: ① leave empty and let the system generate; ② copy the prompt below to any AI, then paste the result back.
scenePromptsExample: e.g. Spring sleeps, unaware of dawn... | Misty spring morning, birds singing
scenePromptToolHint: The prompt already includes the scene count and per-scene durations set above, identical to the system-generated one. Copy it to any AI, fill in your poem, let it generate scenes, then paste the result (one "verse | description" per line) back into the box above.
poetrySubtitleFixed: Poetry subtitles use a fixed universal style (bottom-center, white text, black outline) — toggle only, not customizable.
imagePromptPlaceholder: A lake at the foot of snow-capped mountains, morning mist, mountains reflected in the water, cinematic lighting, landscape orientation
refImageHint: Optional. Upload to generate variations; leave blank for pure AI generation.
anchorPromptPlaceholder: A professional news anchor in a suit, sitting in a modern news studio...
anchorRefImageHint: Optional. Upload to fine-tune the anchor appearance; leave blank for pure AI generation.
scriptTextPlaceholder: Welcome to today's tech bulletin. First story: AI video generation has entered the free era - anyone can turn a text prompt into a short video...
subPositionHintsPlaceholder: Place subtitles in the lower third, avoid covering the anchor's face
audioPostStitchDesc: Audio quality controllable (voice, speed), but lip sync harder to match
audioModelDesc: Audio controlled by model, effect unpredictable; no voice/speed options
systemPromptPlaceholder: Extra instructions for the model (e.g. style, quality), does not affect the subject description
deleteArtifactConfirm: Delete this artifact? This will cascade delete all subsequent artifacts and reset task status.
waitTip: 💡 While you wait, see what others create with Agnes
adSupportDesc: Completely free & open source, never charged. Support the project:
adStarDesc: Help more people discover this tool
adAdblockDesc: Turn off ad blockers on the official site
subStyleHintsPlaceholder: Emphasized words in large red text, regular narration in small white text at the bottom
editArtifactHint: Affected downstream artifacts will be regenerated when you continue
editTextOnly: Only text artifacts can be edited online
noEditableText: No editable text artifacts at this checkpoint
apiKeyAppendPlaceholder: Paste new API Key (auto-appended to existing keys, no need to re-enter old ones)
deleteTaskConfirm: Delete this task and all its generated files? This cannot be undone!
execModeHint: Auto mode runs to completion without intervention; manual mode pauses at each checkpoint for you to confirm or modify artifacts, and can be used with external AI tools. You can switch at any time while running.
keySrcEnvHint: From environment variable; modify it in the startup environment/.env
keyDomainNotSetHint: This Key has no bound domain and will fall back to the global config. We recommend choosing a matching domain for each Key.
keyDomainSelectTitle: Bind a domain to this Key (empty = follow global)
detectKeysHint: Automatically probe and bind a matching domain for each Key
detectKeysBusy: Detection in progress or triggered too frequently, please try again later
keyStillActive: Key still active (still present in env)
sceneRefDesc: Upload a reference image for each scene; the video will use it as the visual starting point (skipping AI storyboard generation for that scene). Scenes without an upload use AI-generated images.
fbRetryHint: Generation failures are often caused by transient factors such as model service fluctuations, network timeouts, or rate limiting. Please retry first (the task resumes from the failed step).
fbCollapsedHint: Still failing after multiple retries? Report the issue
fbExpandedHint: Still failing after {n} retries. Please report with the diagnostic info attached.
fbDeterministicHint: This error looks like a deterministic issue caused by parameters or content. Retrying is unlikely to help; reporting directly is recommended.
fbCopied: Copied. Please paste it into the GitHub Issue.
fbPrivacyHint: Please review the content before submitting (your prompt text is not included)
fbUrlTooLong: The prefilled content was too long and has been shortened. Please paste the full diagnostic info you just copied.
fbRepReproHint: <!-- Please fill in: operations and related config -->
fbRepTruncated: …(content was too long and truncated, please paste the full diagnostic info)
gaOptOutHint: When enabled, only a single anonymous page view (for PV/UV stats) is kept; no other information is reported.
gaReportTitle: When analytics is on, the following is reported anonymously
gaReportItem1: Task events: create, complete, fail, stop, delete
gaReportItem2: Task type and generation mode (e.g. Simple/t2v, Creative)
gaReportItem3: UI and config actions: switch task type, select models, save/clear API keys, domain, watermark toggle (action only, never the key itself)
gaReportItem4: Frontend error summary: error message (truncated to 500 characters)
gaNeverUploadTitle: The following is never uploaded, regardless of the toggle
gaNeverUploadText: Creative content such as prompts, manuscripts, and poem texts; API keys; reference images. All content fields are replaced with a <redacted> marker before reporting, long texts are truncated, and nothing enters the analytics system.
